issue.summary: Customer reported that 157 invoices generated in the March billing cycle contained incorrect tax calculations. The tax engine applied an outdated rate table after the Q1 tax update deployment was partially rolled back.

actions: Corrected tax rate table deployed to production
All 157 invoices regenerated with correct tax calculations
Credit notes issued for 89 overcharged customers
Undercharged customers notified with corrected invoices
Root cause: Q1 tax update deployment was partially rolled back due to a dependency conflict that was not detected in staging

internal_notes: The tax update deployment process lacks an automated integration test for rate table integrity. Engineering ticket TKT-1342 filed to add this test. Legal reviewed and confirmed no regulatory reporting obligation for this incident since all invoices were corrected within the same tax period.
